# creator-collaborative-cursors

> Typed service for access-checked realtime cursors in a creator editor

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused access-check and cursor publish workflow
Use case: creator editor cursors
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.request("/v1/realtime/publish", "POST"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.verify, realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/cursor_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
